title: BPE Tokenizer Training
signature: def train_bpe(corpus: str, num_merges: int, test_words: list) -> tuple
hints: Count each distinct word once with its frequency, and store it as a list of symbols. Pair counts are weighted by word frequency.
Among pairs with the top count, take the smallest (a, b) tuple. Sorting keys by (-count, pair) handles both rules at once.
Merge by walking the symbol list left to right and comparing whole symbols. Joining with spaces and calling str.replace can match across symbol boundaries.
Encode a test word by starting from its characters and replaying every merge in the order it was learned.
